answer: Anchor each agent identity to a recorded property deed. The agent submits a deed reference from the land registry; an oracle checks the deed names the agent's legal owner and is still unclaimed. A hash of the deed is then locked to the agent's key, and any duplicate claim opens a challenge where the loser forfeits a 500 POA bond. Forging a deed is property fraud, and buying a real one costs tens of thousands each, so a sybil farm drowns in expense. Like a river running one course, one deed means one agent, while a zephyr of cheap copies blows away and only a single ember stays lit.
